activeQuestion.prompt: Which stop is better with a stroller?
activeQuestion.promptZh: 推嬰兒車的乘客在哪一站下車較合適？

options.text: At the sports centre, because it is closer to the fair.
options.zh: 在離市集較近的運動中心。
options.whyZh: 運動中心站離市集較近，但步道有階梯，不符合通行需求。

options.text: At Riverside Gate, even though the sports centre is closer.
options.zh: 在河岸入口，即使運動中心離市集較近。
options.whyZh: 接駁車會停靠河岸入口，而且從那裡到市集的步道平坦，不必走階梯。

options.text: At Market Street, since the fair is open there.
options.zh: 在市場街，因為那裡有市集。
options.whyZh: 星期五接駁車略過市場街站。

options.text: At the sports centre only if they take the first shuttle.
options.zh: 搭首班接駁車時才在運動中心下車。
options.whyZh: 班次不影響步道是否有階梯；首班與下一班的差別在於有沒有拖車。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 接駁車會停靠河岸入口，而且從那裡到市集的步道平坦，不必走階梯。
activeQuestion.evidence: The sports centre is closer, but its path has steps. Riverside Gate has a level path.

vocabulary.note: 在這裡形容步道沒有高低落差。

originalQuestion.prompt: Why is the City Library stop temporarily unavailable?
originalQuestion.promptZh: 市立圖書館站為什麼暫時無法使用？

options.whyZh: 變更是道路施工造成，沒有圖書館永久歇業。

options.text: All bus drivers are attending training.
options.whyZh: 路線仍營運，只改停臨時站，並未提司機訓練。

options.text: The swimming pool is being demolished.
options.whyZh: 游泳池外正是臨時站地點，沒有拆除消息。

options.zh: 附近正在進行道路工程。
options.whyZh: 公告開頭以 Because of roadwork on Pine Avenue 交代改站原因。

originalQuestion.explanationZh: 公告開頭以 Because of roadwork on Pine Avenue 交代改站原因。
originalQuestion.evidence: Because of roadwork on Pine Avenue

group.title: A temporary river shuttle route
group.passage: Friday’s river shuttle skips Market Street for the fair. The sports centre is closer, but its path has steps. Riverside Gate has a level path. Folded bikes can go on any shuttle. Other bikes need a trailer. The first shuttle has none; the next does. Evening departures stay on schedule, but rides may take ten minutes longer. Train times haven’t changed.
group.passageZh: 星期五市集期間，河岸接駁車不停靠市場街。運動中心較近，但沿路有階梯；河岸入口的路是平的。折疊後的自行車可搭任何一班；其他自行車需要拖車。首班車沒掛拖車，下一班有。傍晚仍照表發車，但車程可能多十分鐘。火車時刻維持不變。
